hints.title: Arithmetic Progression Membership
hints.text: An arithmetic triplet with common difference diff consists of values x, x + diff, and x + 2 * diff.

hints.title: Lookup Set Verification
hints.text: Store all numbers in a lookup set since nums is strictly increasing.

hints.title: Simultaneous Membership Check
hints.text: For each x in nums, increment the count if both x + diff and x + 2 * diff exist in the set.

hints.title: Set Membership Query Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass with O(1) set membership lookups.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all triplets directly requires cubic O(n^3) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Converts triplet search into hash set lookups using fixed difference properties.
